headline: European TTF Natural Gas Futures Drop Below €88 per Megawatt-Hour
summary: Front-month TTF natural gas futures contracts on the Amsterdam exchange declined over 4% to trade below €88 per megawatt-hour.
why: TTF natural gas prices serve as the benchmark for European wholesale energy costs, impacting industrial margins and utility pricing.
why_moved: Comfortable storage inventories and subdued near-term consumption forecasts prompted selling pressure on benchmark European gas futures.
